dict.string: Tulpa records your microphone only while you or your agent have started listening, and stops when you pause or quit from the menu bar.
Tulpa records the sound your Mac plays (for example the other side of a call) only while listening is started, and stops when you pause or quit from the menu bar.
Tulpa takes one photo with your camera only when your agent asks for one and the eyes are on in its settings. It never records video; Pause in the menu bar refuses every photo.
